top_deficiency_types.title: Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.
Install emergency lighting that can last at least 1 1/2 hours.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.
Ensure smoke barriers are constructed to a 1 hour fire resistance rating.
Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.
